verdict: A real dip in ad returns this week; we're acting on it now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads generated 22 purchases and $5,125 in revenue at a 3.45 return on ad spend, but the most recent week showed a sharp pullback — purchases dropped 56% and return on ad spend fell 47% compared to the prior week, confirming a genuine downtrend rather than a one-week blip. The top campaign has been absorbing more than half of total spend against a narrow audience, and the data points to that audience reaching its limit with the current creative. The Live-Cooking Shoot footage, which the next round of ads depends on, is being prioritized this week to get new creative into rotation. Separately, your Google Business Profile showed zero engagement actions on the last two days of the period, which we're investigating now; expect a clear answer before next week's report. With fresh creative in-flight and the audience issue being addressed, we expect ad efficiency to stabilize in the coming period.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement went dark on Aug 23–24 after averaging roughly 18 actions per day — a possible listing issue.
watch_item.fix: We're auditing the listing now and will have a diagnosis and resolution in place before next week's report.
